        MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => p.pressure z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume →
          (∀ (σ : ℝ) (j : Fin 3),
              Breakdown.IsWeakGradient (fun y => (fderiv ℝ (p.theta σ) y) (Breakdown.unitVector j)) fun y =>
                (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.secondDeriv (p.theta σ) y).flip (Breakdown.unitVector j)) →
            (∀ (σ : ℝ) (j : Fin 3),
                Breakdown.IsWeakGradient (fun y => (fderiv ℝ (p.phi σ) y) (Breakdown.unitVector j)) fun y =>
                  (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.secondDeriv (p.phi σ) y).flip (Breakdown.unitVector j)) →
              (∀ (σ : ℝ),
                  Breakdown.AdjointDefect.IsWeakMatrixDivergence (p.flux σ)
                    (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.matrixDivergence (p.flux σ))) →
                (∀ (σ : ℝ),
                    Breakdown.AdjointDefect.IsWeakScalarGradient (p.pressure σ) (Breakdown.gradientAt (p.pressure σ))) →
                  (∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                      ‖p.theta σ y‖ ≤ C / (1 + ‖y‖) ^ 2 ∧
                        ‖fderiv ℝ (p.theta σ) y‖ ≤ C / (1 + ‖y‖) ^ 3 ∧
                          ‖p.phi σ y‖ ≤ C / (1 + ‖y‖) ∧
                            ‖fderiv ℝ (p.phi σ) y‖ ≤ C / (1 + ‖y‖) ^ 2 ∧
                              ‖p.flux σ y‖ ≤ C / (1 + ‖y‖) ^ 2 ∧ |p.pressure σ y| ≤ C / (1 + ‖y‖) ^ 2) →
                    (∀ (σ : ℝ),
                        ∀ᵐ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                          ‖Breakdown.secondDerivTrace (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.secondDeriv (p.theta σ) y)‖ ≤
                              C / (1 + ‖y‖) ^ 4 ∧
                            ‖Breakdown.secondDerivTrace (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.secondDeriv (p.phi σ) y)‖ ≤
                                C / (1 + ‖y‖) ^ 3 ∧
                              ‖y‖ * ‖Breakdown.AdjointDefect.matrixDivergence (p.flux σ) y‖ ≤ C / (1 + ‖y‖) ^ 2 ∧
                                ‖y‖ * ‖Breakdown.gradientAt (p.pressure σ) y‖ ≤ C ∧
                                  ‖y‖ ^ 3 * ‖Breakdown.gradientAt (p.pressure σ) y‖ ≤ C) →
                      Breakdown.AdjointDefect.IsPotentialData p C

      ∀ (α β α' β' c : ℂ),
        (∀ (v : Breakdown.Space), ψ' v = α * ↑(inner ℝ y v) + β * ↑(v.ofLp 2)) →

                        h v • Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.Internal.FieldPot.ofRealL v)))
                y =
              Breakdown.CertCell.GivenShape.realPartVec
                (c •
                  ![-(α * ↑(y.ofLp 2) + β) * ↑(y.ofLp 0) - β' * ↑(y.ofLp 1),
                    -(α * ↑(y.ofLp 2) + β) * ↑(y.ofLp 1) + β' * ↑(y.ofLp 0),

declarations.name: Breakdown.AdjointDefect.Internal.Representation.limit_identities
declarations.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} {Γ : Set Breakdown.Symmetry} {P D C γ : ℝ} {W ζ : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space}
  {b : Fin k → ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space} {v g F : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space}
  {G : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space}
  {H : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space},
  Breakdown.AdjointDefect.IsFlowPiece W D →
    Breakdown.AdjointDefect.IsAdjointField ζ C γ →
      Breakdown.IsPerturbation Γ P v G H g →
        MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => F z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume →
          Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic F →
            (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y => ‖F σ y‖ ^ 2) < ⊤ →
              Breakdown.IsRightSide W b 0 v G g F →
                ∀ {φ : ℕ → ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space},
                  (∀ (n : ℕ), Breakdown.IsSpaceTimeTestField (φ n)) →
                    Filter.Tendsto
                        (fun n =>
                          ∫⁻ (z : ℝ × Breakdown.Space),
                            ENNReal.ofReal
                              (‖φ n z.1 z.2 -
                                    Breakdown.AdjointDefect.timeCutoff Breakdown.RepresentationParts.windowBump ζ z.1
                                      z.2‖ ^
                                2))
                        Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
                      Filter.Tendsto
                          (fun n =>
                            ∫⁻ (z : ℝ × Breakdown.Space),
                              ENNReal.ofReal
                                (Breakdown.matSq
                                  (fderiv ℝ (φ n z.1) z.2 -
                                    fderiv ℝ
                                      (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.timeCutoff Breakdown.RepresentationParts.windowBump ζ
                                        z.1)
                                      z.2)))
                          Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
                        Filter.Tendsto
                            (fun n =>
                              Breakdown.AdjointDefect.mixedNorm fun s y =>
                                φ n s y -
                                  Breakdown.AdjointDefect.timeCutoff Breakdown.RepresentationParts.windowBump ζ s y)
                            Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
                          Filter.Tendsto
                              (fun n =>
                                Breakdown.AdjointDefect.mixedNorm fun s y =>
                                  Breakdown.AdjointDefect.timeDerivative (φ n) s y -
                                    Breakdown.AdjointDefect.timeDerivative
                                      (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.timeCutoff Breakdown.RepresentationParts.windowBump ζ) s
                                      y)
                              Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
                            Filter.Tendsto
                                (fun n =>
                                  Breakdown.AdjointDefect.mixedNorm fun s y =>
                                    (fderiv ℝ (φ n s) y) y -
                                      (fderiv ℝ
                                          (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.timeCutoff Breakdown.RepresentationParts.windowBump ζ
                                            s)
                                          y)
                                        y)
                                Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
                              MeasureTheory.Integrable
                                  (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.Internal.Representation.pairF F
                                    (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.timeCutoff Breakdown.RepresentationParts.windowBump ζ))
                                  MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                MeasureTheory.Integrable
                                    (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.Internal.Representation.pairF g
                                      (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.timeCutoff Breakdown.RepresentationParts.windowBump ζ))
                                    MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                  MeasureTheory.Integrable
                                      (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.Internal.Representation.pairGW G W
                                        (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.timeCutoff Breakdown.RepresentationParts.windowBump ζ))
                                      MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                    MeasureTheory.Integrable
                                        (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.Internal.Representation.pairWv W v
                                          (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.timeCutoff Breakdown.RepresentationParts.windowBump
                                            ζ))
                                        MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                      MeasureTheory.Integrable
                                          (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.Internal.Representation.pairG G
                                            (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.timeCutoff Breakdown.RepresentationParts.windowBump
                                              ζ))
                                          MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                        MeasureTheory.Integrable
                                            (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.Internal.Representation.pairT P v
                                              (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.timeCutoff
                                                Breakdown.RepresentationParts.windowBump ζ))
                                            MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                          ∫ (z : ℝ × Breakdown.Space),
                                                Breakdown.AdjointDefect.Internal.Representation.pairF F
                                                  (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.timeCutoff
                                                    Breakdown.RepresentationParts.windowBump ζ)
                                                  z =
                                              (((∫ (z : ℝ × Breakdown.Space),
                                                      Breakdown.AdjointDefect.Internal.Representation.pairF g
                                                        (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.timeCutoff
                                                          Breakdown.RepresentationParts.windowBump ζ)
                                                        z) +
                                                    ∫ (z : ℝ × Breakdown.Space),
                                                      Breakdown.AdjointDefect.Internal.Representation.pairGW G W
                                                        (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.timeCutoff
                                                          Breakdown.RepresentationParts.windowBump ζ)
                                                        z) +
                                                  ∫ (z : ℝ × Breakdown.Space),
                                                    Breakdown.AdjointDefect.Internal.Representation.pairWv W v
                                                      (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.timeCutoff
                                                        Breakdown.RepresentationParts.windowBump ζ)
                                                      z) +
                                                ∫ (z : ℝ × Breakdown.Space),
                                                  Breakdown.AdjointDefect.Internal.Representation.pairG G
                                                    (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.timeCutoff
                                                      Breakdown.RepresentationParts.windowBump ζ)
                                                    z ∧
                                            ∫ (z : ℝ × Breakdown.Space),
                                                Breakdown.AdjointDefect.Internal.Representation.pairT P v
                                                  (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.timeCutoff
                                                    Breakdown.RepresentationParts.windowBump ζ)
                                                  z =
                                              ∫ (z : ℝ × Breakdown.Space),
                                                Breakdown.AdjointDefect.Internal.Representation.pairF g
                                                  (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.timeCutoff
                                                    Breakdown.RepresentationParts.windowBump ζ)
                                                  z
